metadata.name: FixPulse AI - Autonomous Property Maintenance Dispatcher

idea: Autonomous Property Maintenance Dispatcher for residential landlords that ingests tenant issue photos, verifies severity via vision AI, generates trade-specific contractor scopes, and collects competitive quotes.

competitors.name: Buildium
weaknesses: Requires property manager to manually call contractors

competitors.name: Latchel
weaknesses: High cost per unit per month ($4-$7)

competitors.name: HappyCo
weaknesses: Does not handle automated vendor dispatching

trends: Property management labor shortage creating 72-hour average delays on emergency maintenance
Tenants increasingly prefer photo/text-based reporting over phone calls
Vision AI models capable of classifying water damage severity from phone photos
risks: Liability if emergency gas/water leak is misclassified as low priority
Contractor quote fraud or unlicensed worker dispatch
Tenant photo quality limitations (poor lighting, wrong angles)

prd.problem_statement: Property managers spend up to 40% of their working hours fielding panicked maintenance calls, diagnosing plumbing/electrical issues with incomplete descriptions, and calling individual contractors for availability.

personas.name: Marcus Vance
pain_points: Gets 2 AM phone calls for leaking toilets
goals: Automated emergency filtering and pre-negotiated trade dispatch

personas.name: Chloe Simmons
pain_points: Submits portal tickets and waits 3 days with no status updates
goals: Instant confirmation and real-time technician ETA tracking

features.name: Vision AI Damage Triage
features.description: Classifies photo of issue into trade (Plumbing, HVAC, Electrical) and urgency.

features.name: Autonomous Contractor RFQ Engine
features.description: SMS broadcast of structured work order to 3 preferred licensed contractors.

features.name: Emergency Water/Gas Cutoff Guidance
features.description: Provides instant illustrated tenant steps to shut off main valves while waiting for technician.

features.name: Landlord Spend Approval Thresholds
features.description: Auto-approves repairs under $250; requests one-click SMS approval for higher bids.

prd.mvp_scope: Support residential plumbing and HVAC repairs with SMS contractor dispatch within 8 weeks using 2 developers.
user_stories: As a tenant with a leaking pipe, I want immediate valve shutoff instructions so my apartment doesn't flood.
As a property manager, I want bids collected automatically so I approve repairs with 1 tap.
As a contractor, I want complete photos and exact problem descriptions before driving out.
success_metrics: Landlord time saved: 12 hours / week per 100 units

stack.justification: High-throughput asynchronous webhooks for Twilio SMS and image uploads
Transactional record of tickets, contractor licenses, and repair timestamps
Frictionless SMS interaction for both tenants and contractors without app installs
Zero egress fee photo and video attachment storage
Fast multimodal image analysis for plumbing and HVAC severity classification

architecture.diagram_mermaid:
graph TD
  Tenant[Tenant SMS / Web Photo] --> Ingest[FastAPI Ingest]
  Ingest --> R2[(Cloudflare R2 Photos)]
  Ingest --> Vision[Vision AI Triage]
  Vision --> TriageDecision{Urgent?}
  TriageDecision -- Yes --> CutoffGuide[Send Tenant Valve Shutoff Guide]
  TriageDecision -- Both --> RFQ[Twilio SMS Contractor Broadcast]
  RFQ --> Contractors[Licensed Local Trades]
  Contractors --> BidIngest[Bids Collected]
  BidIngest --> Landlord[Landlord Approval Tap]
risks: Tenant photo ambiguity requiring secondary prompt clarifying question
Contractor no-shows requiring automated backup contractor escalation
Insurance validation for dispatched third-party trades
